snippet.title: Fragile Reflection | Teaser 1 | PS1 survival indie horror
snippet.description:
Fragile Reflection is the survival horror indie game set in Japan in the late 1990s, in the dark corners of a mysterious city shrouded in darkness and secrets. The game is unique 3rd person survival horror, in the style of retro PlayStation 1 games, deeply inspired by Konami's Silent Hill game franchise.

You play as a young girl named Kario Itto, who returns to her hometown after receiving a disturbing call from the hospital where her father is staying after an accident. Upon arrival, Kario discovers that the city is in ruins, and the streets are inhabited by terrible monsters roaming in the darkness. Now our heroine has to uncover the secrets hiding in the dark corners of the city, unravel what is happening and find her parents.

Lately Kario discovers a strange power that allows her to freely travel to the "Reflected World": scarlet fog hides shards of past events, changing familiar town radically. Player must use this power to solve puzzles and find new paths to travel through town, but also discover hidden secrets of devasted Nankofuraku!
